_README: Values marked 'sourced' were read directly from the official UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2025 flat file (published 10 June 2025). DEFRA has no per-chair/table/light factors, so avoided emissions are DERIVED per item as weight x material factor. Item weights/materials are rough estimates for fictional demo data (weight_is_estimate), so results are labelled 'illustrative', never verified.

source_dataset.name: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors for Company Reporting 2025 (DESNZ/Defra)
source_dataset.caveat: UK factors, used as a proxy for Turkey. Not specific to Turkish fleets or materials.

transport_kgco2e_per_tonne_km.source: DESNZ/Defra 2025, Freighting goods > HGV (all diesel) > All rigids, Average laden, tonne.km, kg CO2e (Scope 3, excludes well-to-tank)
transport_kgco2e_per_tonne_km.note: Rigid trucks chosen as the typical local delivery vehicle. Used only when an item weight is known.

material_kgco2e_per_tonne_primary_produc._note: Emissions of making 1 tonne of NEW material. Embodied emissions of a new item ~ weight_kg/1000 x factor. The material assigned to each item is an assumption.

wood.source: DESNZ/Defra 2025, Material use > Construction > Wood, Primary material production, tonnes

metals.source: DESNZ/Defra 2025, Material use > Construction > Metals, Primary material production, tonnes

plastics_rigid.source: DESNZ/Defra 2025, Material use > Plastic > Plastics: average plastic rigid, Primary material production, tonnes

electrical_large.source: DESNZ/Defra 2025, Material use > Electrical items > Electrical items - large, Primary material production, tonnes

electrical_small.source: DESNZ/Defra 2025, Material use > Electrical items > Electrical items - small, Primary material production, tonnes
